description: This file defines the CustomerAttributeDao interface, which extends a generic DAO interface for CustomerAttribute entities and declares methods for retrieving customer attributes based on different options and IDs.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to CustomerAttribute, extending generic DAO capabilities and adding specific query methods.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by merchant store, customer ID, and attribute option ID.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes by merchant store and option value ID.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes by merchant store and option ID.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes associated with a specific customer in a merchant store.
